lines.vo: Arjun, what happened in AI today?
lines.cap: What happened in AI TODAY?

lines.vo: Six big stories. And the first one shook the whole chip industry.
lines.cap: SIX big stories. The first one shook the chip industry.

lines.vo: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO, effective immediately, after thirty three years.
lines.cap: JENSEN HUANG resigned as Nvidia CEO after 33 years.

lines.vo: Who runs Nvidia now?
lines.cap: Who runs NVIDIA now?

lines.vo: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a successor.
lines.cap: CFO COLETTE KRESS is interim CEO for now.

lines.vo: OpenAI is raising fifteen billion dollars at a one point two five trillion dollar valuation, according to CNBC.
lines.cap: OpenAI raises $15B at a $1.25 TRILLION valuation.

lines.vo: That's huge. But wasn't the goal thirty billion?
lines.cap: Wasn't the goal $30B?

lines.vo: Right. It's half the target, a bridge to a twenty twenty seven IPO.
lines.cap: HALF the target. A bridge to a 2027 IPO.

lines.vo: DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2. It predicts how changes in DNA affect each type of cell.
lines.cap: ALPHAGENOME 2 predicts DNA effects CELL BY CELL.

lines.vo: It finds causal variants thirty percent of the time, up from sixteen. Free for research, not for diagnosis.
lines.cap: 30% causal hits, up from 16%. NOT for diagnosis.

lines.vo: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API. Instead of writing text, it scores choices.
lines.cap: GEMINI DECISIONS API scores choices instead of writing text.

lines.vo: Why would developers want that?
lines.cap: Why would DEVELOPERS want that?

lines.vo: Up to a thousand yes or no questions per request, in about two hundred milliseconds.
lines.cap: 1,000 questions per request in ~200 MS.

lines.vo: OpenAI now lets businesses claim a verified profile inside ChatGPT and see how people engage with them.
lines.cap: Businesses can claim a VERIFIED PROFILE in ChatGPT.

lines.vo: Some can even build a Business Agent that answers customer questions.
lines.cap: Plus a BUSINESS AGENT that answers customers.

items.s: no bookings by personal AI assistants

lines.vo: And United Airlines is blocking third party AI agents from booking flights.
lines.cap: UNITED blocks AI agents from booking flights.

lines.vo: So my AI assistant can't book my trip?
lines.cap: My AI assistant can't BOOK MY TRIP?

lines.vo: Not on United, for now. They cite security and check-in rules.
lines.cap: Not for now. SECURITY and CHECK-IN rules.

lines.vo: That's a lot for one day!
lines.cap: That's a lot for ONE DAY!

lines.cap: FOLLOW @aiwithsufi for daily AI news.
